newsitem.title: USA: American Telecasting gets listing waiver.
newsitem.headline: American Telecasting gets listing waiver.

text.p: American Telecasting Inc said on Wednesday that it had received a temporary exception from The Nasdaq Stock Market Inc for its class A common stock to be listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market.
The temporary exception is subject to certain conditions, which the company presently does not meet, and is limited in duration.
If American Telecasting is unable to satisfy the conditions in the time permitted, then company expects that its shares will be delisted.
American Telecasting operates wireless cable television systems, delivering customer service and offering value-priced programming.
